mission.title: opentelemetry-collector: [processors/batch] Size calculations inconsistent, causing unbounded batch size in bytes
mission.description: [processors/batch] Size calculations inconsistent, causing unbounded batch size in bytes. This issue affects 20+ users.

steps.title: Identify opentelemetry-collector troubleshoot symptoms
steps.description:
Check for the issue in your opentelemetry-collector deployment:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n opentelemetry-collector -l app.kubernetes.io/name=opentelemetry-collector
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=opentelemetry-collector -n opentelemetry-collector --tail=100 | grep -i error
```
Look for errors or warnings in the logs that may indicate the issue.

steps.title: Review opentelemetry-collector configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant opentelemetry-collector configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n opentelemetry-collector -l app.kubernetes.io/name=opentelemetry-collector
kubectl get configmap -n opentelemetry-collector -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=opentelemetry-collector
```
The `batch` processor is not limiting batch size by bytes, but rather by item count. I believe this is due to confusing nomenclature, let me try to explain...

steps.title: Apply the fix for [processors/batch] Size calculations inconsistent, causing…
steps.description:
This fixes a bug with the batch processor's `batch_send_size` and `batch_send_size_bytes` metrics. Their values were being calculated before `SendBatchMaxSize` was applied.

We observed this issue during performance testing. With `SendBatchMaxSize` set to a small enough value that it almost always
```yaml
receivers:
  fluentforward:
    endpoint: 0.0.0.0:8006

processors:
  batch:

exporters:
  logging:
    loglevel: debug
  otlphttp:
    endpoint: https://redacted
    headers:
      authorization: Basic redacted

service:
  pipelines:
    logs:
      receivers: [fluentforward]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [otlphttp, logging]
```

steps.title: Confirm [processors/batch] Size calculations… is resolved
steps.description:
Verify the fix by checking that the original error no longer occurs:
```bash
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=opentelemetry-collector -n opentelemetry-collector --tail=50 --since=5m
kubectl get events -n opentelemetry-collector --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm that the issue symptoms are gone.

resolution.summary:
This fixes a bug with the batch processor's `batch_send_size` and `batch_send_size_bytes` metrics. Their values were being calculated before `SendBatchMaxSize` was applied.

We observed this issue during performance testing.
